description: Telecard Limited is a Pakistani telecommunications company providing enterprise voice and data services. It runs long-distance and international carrier connectivity, UAN and toll-free access services, contact-centre and IP-PBX platforms, CRM and automated-call products, and infrastructure and colocation hosting. Through its subsidiaries — Hallmark Company Limited, Supernet, Supersecure and Supernet Infrastructure Solutions — it also covers IT hardware, systems integration, managed security and ICT infrastructure. The company has operated for more than 25 years and is listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
